name: Deprecation and Tombstone Handling
description: When a schema field or version is deprecated, define the tombstone timeline, migration path, and consumer notification.
purpose: Deprecation is safe and communicated, not silent.
acceptanceCriteria: Deprecation policy documented with timeline phases (announced, sunset, removed)
Tombstone schema format defined (preserves metadata, replaces removed content)
Migration path provided for each deprecated field or version
Consumer notification mechanism (email, webhook, or dashboard alert)
Registry tracks deprecation status and tombstone history
Automated warning in generated types for deprecated fields
Deprecation dashboard shows upcoming and active deprecations
